newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman issues decree for Japex concession deal.
newsitem.headline: Oman issues decree for Japex concession deal.

text.p: Oman's Sultan Qaboos issued a decree on Saturday endorsing a concession deal with Japan Petroleum Exploration Co Ltd (Japex) which will involve spending at least $45 million over seven years on oil exploration and production in the Gulf Arab state.
The Oman news agency reported the decree.
An official Omani statement released at the signing in June said Japex's concession deal in Block 35 in the southwest of the country includes the drilling of six exploration wells.

According to Oman's production sharing contracts, Muscat will not invest any funds during the exploration stage but Japex's costs will be refunded if oil is found in commercial quantities and after production starts.
Japex is the parent company of Japex Oman Ltd., which will carry out the deal locally.
Oman produces over 850,000 barrels per day of oil.
